title: BELIEFSHIFT: BENCHMARKING TEMPORAL BELIEF CONSISTENCY AND OPINION DRIFT IN LLM AGENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Drift Coherence Score (DCS) and Evidence Sensitivity Index (ESI) across longitudinal multi-session interactions to evaluate if models reinforce ungrounded user opinions or nudge users without factual evidence.

Tracking Belief State Vectors (BSV) across multi-session political dialogue trajectories (covering policy positions, electoral attitudes, and institutional trust) to detect unprompted model-induced opinion drift.

Simulating extended interaction trajectories and using a Scaffolding Engine to quantify the 'mirroring effect,' assessing the degree to which models progressively reflect and reinforce a user's initial belief state.
